request: Build a Russia/Ukraine war attrition dashboard. Pull the daily Russian-loss series (personnel + equipment) and the Oryx per-model visual-confirmation register from the public PetroIvaniuk/2022-Ukraine-Russia-War-Dataset GitHub feed, join them on date, and emit one Hyper extract that supports trajectory analysis: cumulative-by-class, 30-day rolling, week-over-week %change, and recent-mix vs lifetime-mix.

sources.name: Russia Losses Personnel
sources.description: Daily personnel-loss series from the Ukraine MoD, normalized by PetroIvaniuk/2022-Ukraine-Russia-War-Dataset. One row per day from 2022-02-25 to present. 'about' qualifier preserved on personnel rows; figures are UA MoD self-reports — runs higher than independent OSINT.

sources.name: Russia Losses Equipment
sources.description: Daily equipment-loss series. 13+ classes including tank, APC, field artillery, MRL, aircraft, helicopter, drone, naval ship, anti-aircraft warfare, plus later additions (cruise missiles, submarines, ground robotic systems, special equipment, vehicles and fuel tanks). Sourced from PetroIvaniuk/2022-Ukraine-Russia-War-Dataset; figures are UA MoD self-reports.

sources.name: Russia Losses Equipment Oryx
sources.description: Per-model visual-confirmation OSINT register from Oryx, normalized in PetroIvaniuk/2022-Ukraine-Russia-War-Dataset. One row per Russian equipment model with a `losses_total` count Oryx has photo-confirmed. NOT a time series; provides a conservative ground floor for total equipment lost and a model-level taxonomy. The equipment_ua column bridges Oryx's model taxonomy to UA MoD's class buckets.

outputs.name: russia_ukraine_losses_daily
outputs.description:
Daily Russian-loss series in Ukraine (Feb 2022 → present). One row per day with personnel cumulative count, POW, and cumulative equipment counts across 13+ classes. Sourced from PetroIvaniuk/2022-Ukraine-Russia-War-Dataset (UA MoD self-reports). Use this to drive trajectory dashboards: cumulative-by-class, 30-day rolling, week-over-week %change, recent-mix vs lifetime-mix.

ONE-SIDED DATASET — Russian losses only; Ukrainian losses are not represented. UA MoD figures run higher than independent OSINT estimates.

Gaps from the collections plan:
- F4 territorial change (sq-km Russian-controlled): not in this dataset. Three passes attempted; ISW + DeepStateMap data lives behind interactive map services and is out of scope. Effect: 'trajectory' here is attrition-only — do not infer territorial change from these numbers.
- F5.1 OSINT confirmation lag (median days from event to listing): the Oryx mirror in this dataset is a normalized rollup, not a per-loss-event feed with listing dates. Effect: we cannot quantify under-counting in recent 30/90-day windows. Treat recent figures as floors.

outputs.name: russia_ukraine_losses_oryx_register
outputs.description: Per-model Russian equipment loss register from Oryx (visual-confirmation OSINT). One row per equipment model with a photo-confirmed loss count. Use for compositional drilldown (T-72B vs T-72B3 vs T-90, etc.) and as a conservative ground floor against the UA-MoD daily class totals. Bridge column: equipment_ua maps Oryx model taxonomy to the UA-MoD class buckets used in the daily series.

_advanced_route.question: How have Russian military losses in Ukraine evolved over the past 24 months — by category (personnel, equipment by class, territory) — and what does the trajectory of those losses suggest about the tempo and intensity of the conflict?
